oven.note: Sourced from Dacor's official user/care manual PDF, since Dacor does not run a standard web support-article section the way most brands do (Dacor is a Samsung subsidiary; manuals are hosted on Samsung's CDN and linked from dacor.com).

codes.meaning: The control panel detected a button being held down or shorted out for too long, often from moisture or debris on the touchpad.
The door-lock mechanism isn't sitting where the control expects, so it can't confirm the door is properly locked.
The oven's main control board has lost its internal communication link with a secondary circuit board.
The main oven temperature probe is reading either a broken or short-circuited signal while the oven is running.
An internal temperature reading inside the oven's electronics has climbed above the normal safe range.
A sensor that monitors the temperature of the control board itself is reading open or shorted.

range.note: Sourced from Dacor's official user manual PDF (Dacor is a Samsung subsidiary; manuals hosted on Samsung's CDN, linked from dacor.com).

codes.meaning: A control button appears stuck or shorted for too long, commonly caused by water or residue on the touch controls.
The oven door's locking mechanism is out of its expected position.
The range's main control board has lost communication with a secondary board inside the unit.
The oven section's control board can't talk to the separate board managing the cooktop section.
The oven's temperature sensor is giving an open or short-circuit reading during operation.
The meat/food temperature probe is short-circuiting while the oven is in use.

dishwasher.note: Sourced from Dacor's official user manual PDF (Dacor is a Samsung subsidiary; manuals hosted on Samsung's CDN, linked from dacor.com).

codes.meaning: The dishwasher has detected a possible water leak and triggers a safety check requiring the water supply and power to be shut off.
The unit isn't receiving adequate incoming water, often a closed valve, interrupted supply, or a frozen/blocked line.
The dishwasher is struggling to drain, typically because the drain hose or internal pump passage is clogged or kinked.
Water-heating performance during a cycle isn't meeting expected levels.
The wash pump isn't operating normally and may need a restart or inspection.
The targeted zone-wash spray feature isn't functioning as it should.

cooktop.note: Sourced from Dacor's official induction cooktop manual PDF; Dacor's gas cooktops are knob-controlled with no display and have no digital fault codes.

codes.meaning: The sensor that monitors the glass cooktop surface temperature has failed in an open-circuit state.
The same surface-temperature sensor has short-circuited rather than gone open.
The cooktop's two internal control boards have stopped communicating with each other.
The control board can't communicate with its memory chip that stores settings and calibration data.
The cooling fan motor isn't spinning correctly, which can stem from a wiring fault, blocked blade, or board defect.
The electrical power feeding the cooktop is outside the voltage range the unit is designed to handle.
